records.source_span: Erdan was first elected to the Knesset in the 2003 elections
records.claim: Gilad Erdan was first elected to the Knesset in 2003.

records.source_span: He was appointed Minister of Environmental Protection, and the Minister in charge of coordinating between the Cabinet and the Knesset in the Netanyahu cabinet
records.value: Minister of Environmental Protection; Minister in charge of coordinating between the Cabinet and the Knesset
records.claim: Gilad Erdan was appointed Minister of Environmental Protection and Minister in charge of coordinating between the Cabinet and the Knesset in the Netanyahu cabinet.
Gilad Erdan was born on 30 September 1970.

records.source_span: serves as a member of the Knesset for Likud and the Minister of Public Security, Strategic Affairs and Minister of Information
records.value: Member of Knesset for Likud; Minister of Public Security; Minister of Strategic Affairs; Minister of Information
records.claim: Gilad Erdan serves as a member of the Knesset for Likud and as Minister of Public Security, Strategic Affairs and Minister of Information.

records.source_span: He formerly held the posts of Minister of Environmental Protection, Minister of Communications, Home Front Defense Minister and Minister of Internal Affairs
records.value: Minister of Environmental Protection; Minister of Communications; Home Front Defense Minister; Minister of Internal Affairs
records.claim: Gilad Erdan formerly held the posts of Minister of Environmental Protection, Minister of Communications, Home Front Defense Minister and Minister of Internal Affairs.
